VeilVoice

Irreversible voice de-identification, fully offline. It destroys the biometric voiceprint, pitch, formants, timbre and accent, and leaves the speech transcribable.

This wiki is generated from the repository. Every page here has a source file there, and CI fails if the two disagree, so nothing on it can quietly go stale.

Every crate and every file

The reference is a page for each of the thirteen crates and each source file in them, generated from the doc comments in the code. Each crate page carries its banner, a flowchart of what calls what, and a table of every file in it.

The same pages are on the website, which additionally shows the syntax-highlighted source beside each one.

Generated from the source by tools/docs/generate.py. Releases are signed with key 8101FB3BB28D02FB239E0CDF9CC1C7E7A9B5833A.
